state.lastRunNotes: No new swing trades. AMZN missed Q3 EPS/revenue and is trading right at/below its $240 stop, so the referee's automatic stop-exit will handle it; the 14-day minimum hold doesn't block a stop-out. AAPL's foldable iPhone Duo demand is still described as extraordinary with no new negative news, but price is close to its $365 target with a weak 0.9 R:R now, so just holding. UNH has no fresh news since its Oct 14 earnings beat; thesis and existing plan stand. LLY (Mounjaro +65%, Zepbound +48% in Q3) is a genuine catalyst but the stock is already up 12% in 5 days to a stretched ~44x earnings multiple, so chasing it today on a broad risk-off day (Intel -25% on weak guidance dragging AMD/NVDA down in sympathy) offers poor risk/reward. Growth/core split stays as-is pending AMZN's likely stop-out. Stop-loss exits: AMZN.

trades.sentimentSummary: Analyst commentary strongly bullish on the Duo launch; stock rallying even as broader tech sells off.
